title: Turning Zeeman splitting into switchable charge polarization in a double quantum dot
summary: A magnetic field that acts identically on two quantum dots is not expected to move charge between them. Nevertheless, we show that a uniform Zeeman field can strongly reconfigure and even reverse the single-electron charge polarization of an asymmetric open double quantum dot. Using a symmetry-preserving Green's-function equation-of-motion approach, we identify regimes where the preferred dot occupation reverses while the system remains in the single-electron charge sector.
